0022600017.text: The Brooklyn Nets, still winless at 0-4 and 0-2 at home, host the 3-1 Detroit Pistons, who sit atop the East and the Central. Brooklyn is 14th in the East and fifth in the Atlantic, 3 games back, while Detroit's most recent game was a loss. Tyler Bilodeau is out for Brooklyn with a shoulder sprain and Egor Demin is day-to-day with a leg bruise, a game-time decision, while Detroit will be without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), both out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but in 2025-26 the Nets lost 1-3, including a 138-100 loss in Brooklyn on March 10, 2026.
